title: Data.Map: dictionaries
hints: README 'New syntax': all Map functions are prefixed `Map.`; fromListWith/insertWith combine duplicates; sortBy + comparing + Down handle the ordering.

wordFreq: turn every non-letter into a space and lowercase the rest, split into words, then count with fromListWith (+) over (word, 1) pairs. topN: toList, sort by (count descending, word ascending), take n. inventory: fromListWith (+). restock: insertWith (+). countOf: findWithDefault 0.

Other data: `[if c == '-' then ' ' else c | c <- \"a-b\"]` → \"a b\" · `Map.fromListWith (+) [(c, 1) | c <- \"abca\"]` → fromList [('a',2),('b',1),('c',1)] · `sortBy (comparing (\s -> (length s, s)))` sorts by length, then alphabetically.

`wordFreq text = Map.fromListWith (+) [(w, 1) | w <- words cleaned]` where cleaned maps letters to lowercase and the rest to ' ' · `topN n freq = take n (sortBy (comparing (\(w, c) -> (Down c, w))) (Map.toList freq))`.
